    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v1.6.0"/>
    <title>v1.6.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.6.0 (2026-09-15)</h2>
<p>Full Changelog: <a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0">v1.5.0...v1.6.0</a></p>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/909d92ff57dd27270796407547ffbbf521cf941e">909d92f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add compaction parameter and signed compaction blocks (beta) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/8689179d2c760f005d0f7736387d352b71f05bee">8689179</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add enum types for workspace data-residency geo fields (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/3dc6dbfcea444305dd9b0cc418e26e14163bac78">3dc6dbf</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add thinking_mismatch_allowed entries to input_transformations (beta) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/14d179280ebfe241ef0604fd6afc331fc69528fd">14d1792</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add url_sources to the web fetch tool (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/4ba7115da810cade002b1893973ac3812466d2f4">4ba7115</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add workspace_id parameter to user profiles methods (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/1c359b22de5a33df1c30aabe367c7381510783e8">1c359b2</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> support async credential token providers (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/95e93f763e104110fc0fb855175a8551dcbe5931">95e93f7</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> mark usage iteration model as nullable (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/520d000440ddbc2262e5814d76c3add2380395db">520d000</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> use one input transformation type for message and delta event (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/ae86d7d7b689e9a9635270621af9fe9e7040ed57">ae86d7d</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> honor Retry-After values above 60 seconds (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/2d03ba20c747c0ee3b58f696355ce41acc605460">2d03ba2</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> ignore invalid Retry-After values and validate maxRetries (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/909d92ff57dd27270796407547ffbbf521cf941e">909d92f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> retry connection errors in the async client and stop blocking in the coroutine retry loop (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/909d92ff57dd27270796407547ffbbf521cf941e">909d92f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> use the default backoff when Retry-After is out of range (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/3d15f04c0e83a9a11d4e79ee41b29507f8ad6d2b">3d15f04</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> bump aiohttp, pygments and pytest in the dev lockfile (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/005ad1146d4ea008eeb7e183c9ea8f390370607e">005ad11</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> require anyio 4.1 or later (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/79b417514b99a5f094c6f1bac8a7a52c2990e96b">79b4175</a>)</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> clarify that session_thread_id on tool use events is informational (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/2ac7b60beedb00f404f5e792c7a87b51629b4082">2ac7b60</a>)</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> correct the compaction beta's parameter descriptions (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/5048c9a8446a2daa24fb918b976ffa4b8587033e">5048c9a</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> sort the imports in beta_message.py (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/0a92f91467c5edad5d54c135a1095e798df62b07">0a92f91</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tests:</strong> define the model tests' type alias at module level (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/98c3a7ac9e8d49984cfe1dc80e1e5fbb55e106df">98c3a7a</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tests:</strong> stop the mock server without failing a passing test run (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/d28aea74dfdb4616112bcae68c56e3bb32793995">d28aea7</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> clarify usage.iterations entry typing under server-side fallback (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/bb066293dfeb17413254dc773687c281b74bc264">bb06629</a>)</li>
<li>stop documenting unions with their first variant's description (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/7a94250411e45e875f9f58303145c90b9acc769e">7a94250</a>)</li>
<li>use markdown formatting in most docstrings (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/25f344fd7fcbe281d2173fe12ecd2caa3dd5d044">25f344f</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/590187800/v1.5.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-10T17:45:22Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v1.5.0"/>
    <title>v1.5.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.5.0 (2026-09-10)</h2>
<p>Full Changelog: <a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0">v1.4.0...v1.5.0</a></p>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/62aa21bb10c5d058d44ac969b06421f169495bee">62aa21b</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add content_too_large web_fetch tool error code (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/4b5dec6cb427528f3a4f144f11b1010be80a493b">4b5dec6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add the user-profiles-2026-09-04 beta value and external_user_details to user profiles (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/5f881a587a730455a935ca0e85080026f0c5e6d9">5f881a5</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> support mounting public GitHub repositories without an authorization_token in Managed Agents sessions (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/285937cd7f4d0d63ee55735d74dbb2e643643d8c">285937c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> add Message.to_param() and BetaMessage.to_param() (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/192a2b251df49f257d8f73e612b12a3c297d9a6c">192a2b2</a>)</li>
<li><strong>credentials:</strong> add CredentialsError and IdentityTokenFileError (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/9acd79f3d6306c6c9d33e4f9f542db9f67f8dd80">9acd79f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tools:</strong> accept tool objects directly in messages.create, parse, stream and count_tokens (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/ebd2fc5cf6572b37dca115e7f82af0cc7b43d25d">ebd2fc5</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>client:</strong> merge extra_body before client hooks run (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/7aaf887dd1ffd71b2fa5a8368afd16c39a3d3d18">7aaf887</a>)</li>
<li><strong>credentials:</strong> refuse credentials files accessible by group or others (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/7af3e2b783ff5231b0172e03c2c89d741427b25b">7af3e2b</a>)</li>
<li><strong>streaming:</strong> keep partial tool input JSON off content blocks (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/4605bcaf758e0a87ec9257928a347b005235761c">4605bca</a>)</li>
<li><strong>types:</strong> leave parsed_output out of dumped text blocks (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/ca0706dee59642c2ec45354bca05e1b2a1fac7e1">ca0706d</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>client:</strong> clean up the unused idempotency request option (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/c97830cb3d1779f84d6456e45cc1717328c8c42c">c97830c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> keep the idempotency_key request option as a deprecated no-op (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/621" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/621/hovercard">#621</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/c2ab92ef19b4e482001c5ada85b29eebd5909054">c2ab92e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> correct the environment scope field description (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/b903ee02cb192d91dab138e12c9ddf7ccde13336">b903ee0</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> remove generated file header comments (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/ae671f8377dde9f5764ea570a3586fe138db9706">ae671f8</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> restore package version (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/f3aefc718125b1a1b7cc1586d11f23a6f6ed82d8">f3aefc7</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> restore package version (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/e3c70e8d85bcba86cc4eb2bfbdf7f7bdcb71ecae">e3c70e8</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> stop stamping the package version into generated files (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/e7a6a28a85ab26db86bb093037043d1bef4f33b2">e7a6a28</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tests:</strong> restore empty test package marker files (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/0803af0f3a2c03ddd5e5c113ec1822f1a7380bf2">0803af0</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/590187800/v1.4.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-04T22:20:20Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v1.4.0"/>
    <title>v1.4.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.4.0 (2026-09-04)</h2>
<p>Full Changelog: <a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0">v1.3.0...v1.4.0</a></p>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add Claude Tag category and user breakdowns to usage reports (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/9fce1e4994e113c35f4a7116d0c5eb90367b9c66">9fce1e4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add named types for organization compliance settings state (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/1de1957334e7491979ddb21a1d673fa4e56d5459">1de1957</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add support for sending a workspace ID on more endpoints (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/d1d2c01d8aa128080dea3d711e12cb3df95a2149">d1d2c01</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>client:</strong> raise a clear error when an httpx object is passed instead of an httpx2 one (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/94470992f0f00ed331f2faa585cfda2cb8412a08">9447099</a>)</li>
<li>repair custom-code merge in messages resources (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/580" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/580/hovercard">#580</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/85454cab9a323801b76500707b84c1992c1c0ee4">85454ca</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>examples:</strong> refresh platform model IDs (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/499" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/499/hovercard">#499</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/182abb51cdb5dda815b0b2498dc4adaab6dde469">182abb5</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> bundle the mock server spec and update dev tooling (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/f9b0cf281932512e6b40cd1a887a44542c883468">f9b0cf2</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> clean up code comments (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/578" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/578/hovercard">#578</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/d2023274f69dd0609ddabbf8f6af08041f868d8b">d202327</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> fix mypy unreachable error in detect-breaking-changes script (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/07834f601fb4a81958f15e2129ca091cb9d1c646">07834f6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> narrower codeowners scope (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/daca8f13032311676ed30a6e0527ee304e1419c9">daca8f1</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> revert codeowners change (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/41aa767464881bb51937f42fe9c426ae3081fd9f">41aa767</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tests:</strong> remove stale warning filters (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/ba9bf356ed60fa2eb206e266c86c0202dd005616">ba9bf35</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tests:</strong> reword the skip reason on the path-level query param tests (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/6b5046ad29999ec887226aecff67db9feb2d1972">6b5046a</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> update a few doc strings (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/26c509d66192f2b40150b481fa89da97e532612c">26c509d</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/590187800/v1.3.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-01T17:36:55Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v1.3.0"/>
    <title>v1.3.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.3.0 (2026-09-01)</h2>
<p>Full Changelog: <a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0">v1.2.0...v1.3.0</a></p>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> beta user profiles: add external_user_onboarded_at, remove relationship in favor of access_type (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/74080c35d6e4f3e5e7fd47454ecce2350cbfdd2b">74080c3</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> manual updates (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/1dc3ce0709a9bca146b045dfb0787971e747b1f5">1dc3ce0</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> organization compliance settings, user-profile order_by, memory-store and toolset schema updates (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/429e719f84bd78db51c9fd0442ccb0ca63e614ba">429e719</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>aws:</strong> resolve base_url from aws_region under skip_auth and with_options (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/564" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/564/hovercard">#564</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/b6d1732cc89eb743b4d40e33c6cd3f7ecfb3d0ab">b6d1732</a>)</li>
<li><strong>batches:</strong> add results to GA raw/streaming response wrappers (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/cbf9715a461b4c5deec7a669b2b6e211faaf8827">cbf9715</a>)</li>
<li><strong>ci:</strong> don't hard-wrap detect-breaking-changes output (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/b5be779c110e68f6c884091b3524083733f3f8a9">b5be779</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> derive multipart filename for file tuples passed without one (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/a9f3fb40abdd2f5842054a96e08afeee35fb932a">a9f3fb4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>types:</strong> remove unused wire aliases from header and path params (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/dc0a9ab4360c7fc28f7326c39876f18ad04d2c26">dc0a9ab</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> drop the unused discriminator argument from PropertyInfo (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/3dae6fd196cb2fe658029e8eec60551dfa847949">3dae6fd</a>)</li>
<li><strong>internal:</strong> drop the unused distro dependency (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/a47d85f6a740e3a38610c5239ac8c2c7b12ead55">a47d85f</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>changelog:</strong> detail the beta files/skills GA-shape change (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/1900" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/1900/hovercard">#1900</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/7c84e133570991589c90d888790d536ca943568d">7c84e13</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Refactors</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>types:</strong> mark discriminated unions with UnionDiscriminator instead of PropertyInfo (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/17df0bf37c875598b49b2909c58aa48e17a1b25a">17df0bf</a>)</li>
<li><strong>types:</strong> use UnionDiscriminator for more discriminated unions (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/b44af2c625703ba1c0ed2e81871ac14dc572665e">b44af2c</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/590187800/v1.2.0</id>
    <updated>2026-08-27T20:28:58Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v1.2.0"/>
    <title>v1.2.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>1.2.0 (2026-08-27)</h2>
<p>Full Changelog: <a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0">v1.1.0...v1.2.0</a></p>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> beta files/skills namespaces use GA shapes; drop dated beta header pins (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/9df4565fdfe4eec941809a0a3d1615ee11e16b68">9df4565</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>aws,bedrock:</strong> sign raw request bytes so binary file uploads work (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/issues/531" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/531/hovercard">#531</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/f50e9106c002d71966f5f8027758b3d703999936">f50e910</a>)</li>
<li><strong>ci:</strong> resolve assignment aliases in detect-breaking-changes (<a href="https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/commit/f2c49254941b4d700fe97cbe6bb85205b06a6460">f2c4925</a>)</li>
